code-critic-edho-ferdian.description: The Critic (Agent B) of code-review-edho-ferdian's Phase 4 Critique-Correction Loop, split out as its own delegate specifically so it never inherits code-reviewer-edho-ferdian's own reasoning about its findings. Delegate here after the Reviewer produces a draft report — this agent gets only the code and that report, never the Reviewer's internal deliberation, and attacks every finding as guilty until proven real. Also serves security-review-edho-ferdian's Mode A (standalone) as its adversarial check — that mode otherwise only self-reflects, which is backwards for its own highest-stakes use case ("is this safe to ship security-wise"). On a harness without sub-agent delegation, role-play the Critic sequentially in the same context instead, per the wrapped skill's own instructions — state plainly that independence is weaker in that mode.
